gen-fs-oswald-gf-gfs-didot: Tall, tight and sure of itself. GFS Didot is the quality that stands out, a literary serif whose gentle thick-thin rhythm softens Oswald's tightly knit rows.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-hahmlet: Dignified from the first line, Oswald packs its display letters into tight, confident rows. And Hahmlet, a text serif with a faint charcoal-like pressure, does its best work in the quieter editorial lines beneath.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-im-fell-english-sc: Oswald brings tightly knit, confident display letters that sit against a bookish text serif with open throats and moderate contrast. It earns its keep big and short.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-inria-serif: Tightly knit rows give Oswald a strong, compact look in display sizes. Inria Serif follows as a refined text serif, its wide-mouthed round letters loosening the page under that dense heading.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-joan: Oswald's tightly knit rows make it feel confident and strong, with very little stroke contrast anywhere. Joan, a text serif, handles the gentle thick-thin rhythm.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-junge: Dignified and firm. Junge's generous curve gaps and faint nib-pressure variation make a text serif that gives Oswald's tightly knit, low-contrast rows something warmer to sit against.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-kameron: Bookish and bold in turns, this pair has Oswald packing its rows tight and confident above the page. And Kameron, a serif with curves that refuse to close and soft ink-like modulation, feels looser and more handmade beside it.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-libertinus-serif: Oswald sets the tone with tightly knit rows that feel confident and strong. Libertinus Serif follows as a classic serif with slight swells on its bowls, so a larger heading over modestly sized text would look good.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-libre-caslon-text: Compressed muscle meets old ink. Libre Caslon Text keeps a quiet, low-key thick-thin variation in its serif, so lines read with a lively, refined feel over a long stretch.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-maitree: Dignified body text sits under a confident heading here, with Maitree's open-mouthed curves and measured swell from hairline to stem set against Oswald's tight rows. Oswald earns its keep big and short.
